messages.subject: [MonetDB.R] MonetDB.R 0.9.2
messages.body_plain:
Hello MonetDB.R users,

We have been working to get MonetDB.R compatible with dplyr [3]. The 
changes that resulted from this as well as various bug fixes (see [2] 
for details) are available as a (source) pre-release at [1]. I am 
planning to submit this to CRAN next week. It would be great if you 
could test this and let me know if anything is off.

Best and Thanks

Hannes


[1] http://homepages.cwi.nl/~hannes/R/MonetDB.R_0.9.2_7e77fb3c3551.tar.gz

[2] 
http://dev.monetdb.org/hg/MonetDB/file/7e77fb3c3551/clients/R/MonetDB.R/NEWS

[3] https://github.com/hadley/dplyr
